notes:
The app catches up with the desktop again — everything up to desktop 2.16.

- **Extras for every series.** OVAs, specials, movies and credits that come
  with a show now live in their own **Extras** tab instead of cluttering up the
  seasons, and they don't count toward a show's progress or "next episode".
  Long-press an episode to move it into or out of Extras, and a movie can be
  filed under a show as an extra (and moved back to Movies later).
- **Comments.** Every movie has a comments section under its description, and
  every season of a show has a **Comments** button next to *Mark season
  watched*. You see everyone's name and picture, and can delete your own.
- **Long-press a poster** in a library, Watch Later or Recently added to add it
  to a collection or save it to Watch Later without opening it.
- **Rating a movie is a quick pop-up** right on its page, and the Ratings page
  now opens on what you watched last.
- **Watch Later clears itself** once you've finished something.
- **Clearer sign-in.** A plain message when the server can't be reached, and a
  **Forgot password?** link.
- **Set up your profile.** If you haven't added a name and picture yet, the app
  asks you once.
- **Halloween week.** The app dresses up in orange with cobwebs and the odd bat
  flying past, plus a **Halloween** page full of Fright Night picks from the
  library. Settings → Playback → **Seasonal look** turns the decorations off.
- **Edit info no longer moves a title** out of its section by accident.
- **Behind-the-scenes improvements** to keep things running smoothly.

---
Installed apps update themselves: open Unseen Media and accept the update prompt, or use Settings → Updates → Check now.
